classification.difficultyReason: Students identify the total from each cumulative graph, halve it to locate the median position, then trace to the polygon and interpret the horizontal scale, interpolating and rounding where needed.

content.prompt: Find the median from these cumulative frequency histograms and polygons with grouped data. Read graphical estimates to the nearest whole number.

spec.description: Unfilled cumulative histogram and ogive; source grey fill omitted as decorative.
spec.answerVisibility: No median guides or teacher answer.

answer.worked: Median position $=0.5\times90=45$. Read across from cumulative frequency $45$ to the ogive, then down to the horizontal axis: median $\approx7$.
